sentences.sentence: I woke up as a different person today.
I am an altogether different person this year.
But I still feel like the 13-year-old me is watching me over.
I remember how she never wanted to grow up, thinking she would lose herself in the process.
It’s hard for a thirteen-year-old to think of what their life may be like in a few years’ time.
As for my 13-year-old self, I am guessing that you might think that this year I am 14.
However, I am not quite sure if we agree on how to measure age.
We can talk about it a little bit.
When my birthday arrived this year, I was 14 years and 1 month old.
I had a party with my friends.
I did not have a fancy cake or anything like that.
I just ate an apple, and I was happy.
I think it’s funny that people get so excited about your age.
Some people even tell you how much older they are than you.
I have heard people say that they are 10 times as old as some other person.
Is that really true?
How do they measure that?
I know I am going to be 15 soon, so when will I stop being a child?
Some people say that children are 12 and under.
I disagree with them.
That does not make any sense to me.
There are 7-8 year-olds who are as tall as I am.
They are taller than me.
The other thing I noticed is that some people say that you should only be friends with people who are your age.
I do not agree with that either.
I want to be friends with people no matter how old they are.
Age does not matter to me.
I have friends who are 13, 15, 16, and even one friend who is 19!

sentences.sentence: ### Vision 2020: The Well
Recordings, Talk Notes, and Application Questions

Each week, we produce notes, discussion points, and application questions for the Sunday talks — helping you to go deeper into everything we're looking at together and resource our journey through God's Word.
In the last few weeks, we have been learning about what God is doing in the world in His plan of redemption and salvation.
We have seen God's redemptive work in history and we have talked about our role in this plan.
We began a study on a plan that God laid out a couple thousand years ago called Vision 2020.
Vision 2020 was God's plan for the world for 2020 to 2022 and it had two parts to it:
1. A 30% reduction in extreme poverty.
2. A 70% reduction in preventable blindness.
In our last lesson we learned that one of the best ways that we can do this is by giving.
Giving is something that God has asked us to do, and He will give us the opportunity to give.
God's way of giving is by using you!
God gives through you, not from you.
When we share what we have, we are sharing what God has given us.
If you look at a well, there is nothing in a well.
But if you dig a well, the water will come to the well and then you can drink.
In this lesson, I want to talk more about Vision 2020 and how God has used us as a well to give so much to help people all over the world.
We have to remember that Vision 2020 doesn't just stop after 2022.
It was a plan set forth by a man named Dr. Ted Rowland who was working for the Fred Hollows Foundation and it is still going on now.

sentences.sentence: Photo by Jr Korpa on Unsplash
While I’m sharing, if you feel what I’m going through
If you can feel the feelings of the experiences I’m going to share with you
If my spirit touches your spirit
Please, know that I am not alone.
I believe that we all have our own internal world and it's very important for us to listen to what is going on inside of us.
Our internal world can be a very lonely place because no one else can really feel what we feel.
Sometimes we get so lost in our internal world that we forget that there are people who care about us and we can reach out to them.
When I look back at my childhood, I remember being a very happy child, but I would often be scared because of the voices I heard in my head.
These were not voices of people; they were the thoughts I had about myself.
I was scared that I was going to do things wrong or that I wasn't going to be good enough.
I would feel very ashamed of myself and I wouldn't want anyone to know how I was feeling.
As I got older, things didn’t get much better.
It took me a long time to understand that I could talk to someone else about my internal world.
I thought that no one would understand and that no one would ever want to help me.
However, after speaking to people who helped me, I was able to learn that talking about these feelings was very important.
When I learned to share what I was thinking, things started to get better.
Now, as I sit here looking out into the world, I have come to realize that I am not the only person who feels this way.
I believe everyone has their internal world.
Everyone has thoughts they feel ashamed of and no one wants to tell others what they’re going through.
We can feel like we don’t need anyone and sometimes it’s hard to even share what we feel to our closest friends.

sentences.sentence: Illustration by Fresh Idea
Full manuscript in two months.
That was the goal.
I was on vacation in Mexico, no less, when I checked my email and saw the opportunity.
It was mid-June and the conference was happening near the end of June.
As a novelist who had written for 30 years but never got published, this was a rare opportunity.
I am a writer.
I read books.
I wrote short stories.
I wrote essays and a couple of novels that were not published.
However, I did not consider myself a professional writer.
Then, I received the invitation to speak at the conference.
This was my chance.
I needed to use it.
I started writing the manuscript.
I made outlines.
I set goals.
I made a schedule.
Everything looked good, but then something happened.
My ego sabotaged my writing.
My ego made me want to write a book that would be bestseller.
My ego made me think that every detail I put into the book had to be right, had to be perfect.
My ego made me write scenes that I would never publish.
In the end, all the hard work I put into the manuscript and the conference were wasted because my ego made me lose sight of why I wanted to do this in the first place.
I wanted to be heard.
I wanted my voice to be heard, not the voice in my head saying that my novel should be perfect.
What do I think is the solution?
Be aware of your ego.
Don’t let your ego write your manuscript.
Write what you need to write.
If that means you write something that is not perfect, or you have to go back and change things, so be it.
You can do that in revision.
Just get the story down, first and foremost.

sentences.sentence: How prepared are you for the revolution?
Once upon a time, not that long ago in the restaurant, food, and hospitality industry, the formula for success was pretty simple to grasp.
Following the formula was widely accepted as the guaranteed path to making money.
The formula included offering food, drinks, and room service in exchange for paying customers.
But what if I told you that this simple formula has completely changed?
There are many reasons why we have reached a turning point in the hospitality industry.
To answer the question of how prepared you are for the revolution, I think it's essential to look at the forces which are shaking up the hospitality industry.
It is the same way that we would look at the forces which brought the automobile industry to its knees.
In today’s world, there are so many forces that are shaking up the hospitality industry.
For example, there is the rise of online reviews, the rise of mobile phones, and the rise of social media.
All of these things are changing the hospitality industry and they are all changing it very quickly.
When we consider the rise of online reviews, we see that the hotel industry is being shaken up because people can read online reviews of hotels before they stay there.
This means that people can find out more about a hotel and then make their decision on where they want to stay.
This is different from the past when people had to rely on their friends or family to tell them where they should stay.
Now, they can do their own research.
When we think about the rise of mobile phones, we see that there are now new mobile apps which allow people to book rooms and get services without ever having to speak to someone in the hotel.
This means that they are no longer forced to have a conversation with someone in the hotel if they don't want to.
They also don’t have to deal with a person who doesn't speak their language.
Another reason that the hospitality industry is being shaken up is the rise of social media.

sentences.sentence: As the fourth and final song faded, the DJ in our club at the north end of Waikiki kept the crowd pumped for another set of nude women on stage under the flashing black lights.
These men were mostly military dudes who were barely legal.
I was a twenty-something who was there to meet men just like them; in fact, I was there because I’d been told I might see some of them there, and because it had been recommended to me.
But when the nude ladies came out, I had to go.
I’ve always liked going to clubs, but this one was special, as it’s where my now husband and I first met, many years ago.
It’s one of the few things that hasn’t changed in our long marriage and we’ve been together for over forty years now.
But after that night, things did change.
The night was going well, but when all these women came out of nowhere, all naked, it scared me, and I decided to leave.
The first time I walked into that club, we both didn’t know each other and he was there for the same reason.
So he stayed and I left.
After that, it was hard to continue our friendship and eventually, I stopped coming there altogether.

I do understand that everyone has their own personal opinion of how they wish to express themselves and what they think should be allowed, but don't they think someone else might want to express themselves differently?
What if you have a friend you’ve known forever who doesn’t agree with you?
How can he keep the club running if no one comes?
What does it say about us if we accept the right of others to do something that we would not do, even though we may not agree with it?
If I knew that the men who came to this club were mostly there to look at the women, then why would I come back?

sentences.sentence: Liz’s Bio and Featured Stories
If you like true stories with a twist and a life lesson takeaway, read on!
Photo Courtesy of the Author
Dear Reader,
Welcome to my little corner of the world!
I don’t often lay on about myself, but here goes.
I am Liz, an ordinary person, who likes to tell stories that are not so ordinary.
I am a former real estate agent and mother of two adult daughters.
I currently write, teach, and live in a small town where most of the people know each other.
My featured stories today have a little twist to them.
They are true stories, and they have a lesson to be learned.
If you want to continue reading, please keep on.
In my first story, I will talk about Liz the Realtor.
In this life, I am a realtor and love it.
However, not everything that comes through me is as good as it seems to be.
My first featured story will be about the time when I was selling a house.
The house was being sold for $150,000 and had been put on the market for a long time.
It was in a bad part of town, and I was sure no one would buy it.
But someone did!
And they offered $97,500!
I was shocked.
I told them there must be a mistake on their check.
And it turns out, there was a mistake on their check.
They wrote “$97.50” instead of $97,500.
So, what can we learn from this story?
We should always read things twice before we sign on them.
In my second story, I will talk about Liz the Mother.
When both of my children were young, we lived in a very small apartment that was about 480 square feet.

sentences.sentence: Simple Changes That Helped Me Lose 5 Kg and Feel Great in Just One Month
Image by biscotto87
When the pandemic-induced lockdown happened, I lost all motivation.
Up until then, I had been active and in shape, but the whole pandemic situation really messed with my mindset.
I had stopped exercising and was eating way too much.
But the lockdown wasn't going to last forever and, when it ended, I wanted to be able to go out again without any self-consciousness.
So I changed my diet, I started exercising, and I found a lot of motivation from my own body improvement.
My new routine was pretty simple, but very efficient.
I started to eat healthy breakfast, because I know how important it is.
And for the first time ever, I started to eat fruit every day.
I also stopped drinking fizzy drinks and started to drink water with a lemon or lime, which is really refreshing.
In terms of food, I started using olive oil instead of margarine, and I cut sugar as much as possible.
For example, my husband and I bought a coffee machine so we can now make coffee at home.
Coffee is our main daily drink and before we used to buy it from Starbucks, which means that we were consuming a lot of sugar.
But it's not just about what I stopped eating, it's about what I started eating.
I am eating more fruits, vegetables, and fish.
For example, before lockdown, we never had breakfast.
Now, we have eggs or pancakes for breakfast.
And we are snacking on almonds and fruits.
I don't go to restaurants anymore.
When we want to treat each other, we cook something nice at home.
The other part of losing weight is working out.
I stopped going to the gym but started doing HIIT (high intensity interval training).
I did one or two sessions of HIIT per week.

sentences.sentence: The #1 Thing That Gets Me Through Difficult Days
My Coping Mechanism in Trying Times
Photo by Ian Chen on Unsplash
I remember the first few hours after my mother took her last breath.
I also remember the first few days.
Those were difficult days; some of the most challenging that I have ever had to get through.
It was hard not only to get through those days but to continue moving forward, not to mention start living again and to live happily.
It’s safe to say that I could not have got through those days without my coping mechanism, which was to write.
Writing is the thing that gets me through difficult days.
Writing for me has always been about expression.
It has always been about sharing.
It is a tool I use to heal, so writing became my therapy to get through.
It helps me to organize my thoughts and it gives me something to do with all my emotions.
Writing gives me a chance to get all of the bad feelings out so that I don't bottle them up.
It is one way that I can process and get through a lot of the difficult days.
When I was going through a hard time, one of the things that really helped me was to write every day.
I made myself write at least one page, because I realized that it was better to write less and be quality than to write more and be quantity.
In my mind, I did not want to waste the opportunity that I had.
It was not about how many pages I should be writing, but rather about the importance of writing something every single day.
Writing gave me a way to talk to God because it is hard sometimes to talk when you are depressed or down.
I know it is not the same as talking to someone in person, but it was my way of getting through those difficult days.
When I am sad, it helps me to feel better to put it in a written format.

sentences.sentence: Photo by Harry Knight on Unsplash
“Card games, now that’s a good way to pass the time.”
An older woman observes my group of fifteen high school students huddled in circles playing games.
We’ve just spent a week in the mountains.
The sun is shining, the weather is perfect, and there isn’t a cell tower or computer nearby, and yet we are all busy looking at our phones.
I look around the room at the faces of my students.
They appear happy but they seem empty as well.
We’ve had some really good talks about technology during our week in the mountains.
For me, the best talk was one I had with one of the student’s parents.
It was at dinner one night.
Their son was complaining about not being able to post on social media or check his email.
I started telling him that he was going to have to learn to live without computers and mobile devices.
The father looked surprised, almost shocked.
I told him that when I was in high school, there were no computers.
When I got to college, there were very few.
He told me that if he had grown up like that, he wouldn't have gone to college.
He would have thought it was too difficult.
My opinion is simple.
I think our dependence on computers and mobile phones is too great.
Our reliance on them makes us more lonely.
We don’t connect to other people anymore.
We spend our time with them.
I know it sounds a little strange to hear someone who grew up using these things say that.
But it’s true.

documents.inputText:
Photo by Harry Knight on Unsplash

“Card games, now that’s a good way to pass the time.”

An older woman observes my group of fifteen high school students huddled in circles playing games. We’ve just spent a week in the mountains. The sun is shining, the weather is perfect, and there isn’t a cell tower or computer nearby, and yet we are all busy looking at our phones. I look around the room at the faces of my students. They appear happy but they seem empty as well.

We’ve had some really good talks about technology during our week in the mountains. For me, the best talk was one I had with one of the student’s parents. It was at dinner one night. Their son was complaining about not being able to post on social media or check his email. I started telling him that he was going to have to learn to live without computers and mobile devices. The father looked surprised, almost shocked. I told him that when I was in high school, there were no computers. When I got to college, there were very few. He told me that if he had grown up like that, he wouldn't have gone to college. He would have thought it was too difficult.

My opinion is simple. I think our dependence on computers and mobile phones is too great. Our reliance on them makes us more lonely. We don’t connect to other people anymore. We spend our time with them. I know it sounds a little strange to hear someone who grew up using these things say that. But it’s true. When I get home from work and my wife is at the office and my kids are in school and the house is quiet and I have some free time, the first thing I do is pick up my phone. I check Facebook. I check Twitter. I read emails. If I’m out with friends, the first thing I want to do is check my email or read the news online.
